info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Mortgage Loans Preapprovals-v5-spec
info.description: The Mortgage Loans Preapproval Listing API provides access to a comprehensive list of preapproved mortgage loans available to potential borrowers. This API allows users, such as lenders and real estate developers, to retrieve essential information about various preapproval options, enabling more informed decision-making. Typical use cases include evaluating available loan options, comparing terms, and assisting clients in finding suitable mortgage products. The API streamlines the process of loan preapproval and enhances the overall borrower experience.

get.description: This endpoint allows the user to retrieve the status of their loan preapproval request. It returns relevant details regarding the preapproval process and any conditions that might apply.

requestBody.description: Request body for initiating a loan preapproval process. This will typically include the necessary details about the applicant and the desired loan specifications to evaluate eligibility and provide an initial decision.

ListMortgageLoansPreapprovalsRequest.title: Loan Preapproval Request Body
ListMortgageLoansPreapprovalsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for obtaining preapproval for a loan.

status.description: Indicates whether the preapproval request was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the preapproval request.

resultId.description: The ID of the result generated for this preapproval request.

state.description: The current state of the preapproval request.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the preapproval request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the preapproval request result.

ListMortgageLoansPreapprovalsResponse_20.description: Response schema for loan preapproval operation, indicating the outcome of the request.

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user or system that created the request.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the request was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the preapproval request was processed automatically.

AuditDetails.description: Details about the audit of the preapproval request.

x-processing-time.description: The amount of time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request.
